Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Lower values win. A message is dropped while one with a lower value is showing or queued; a message with a lower value than the queued ones clears the queue.

Fields.Name: Force Play
Fields.Description: If set, the message is queued ahead of waiting messages of the same priority that don't have this set.

Fields.Name: White Phantom - Normal
Fields.Description: Network Message text ID shown for this message when the White Phantom - Normal column applies. The column comes from the player's multiplayer role or state. -1: the message is not shown.
